overall_assessment: Anonymization works well for UiA: in all 28 courses the course-coordinator names (single and multi-name 'Emneansvarlige:' blocks, hyphenated and three-part names), breadcrumb, '(Høst YYYY)' title stamps and the FS timestamp (Bokmål and Nynorsk) are removed, no e-mail, phone or admin date is left, and no course content is lost. The pre-pass flags are all false alarms ('name_like' = the font 'Times New Roman'; 'removed' = short header-only stub pages). The only defects are two cosmetic leftovers on two-semester courses: an empty '(–)' in the title and a half-removed teaching semester ' og Vår'.

findings.description: For courses that run over two semesters the UiA title carries a semester range '(Haust 2024–Vår 2025)'. The years and season words are removed (correct), but the brackets and en dash survive, so every such title reads 'NO-505 Masteroppgåve (–)'. Removal residue, harmless for meaning. Across all UiA offerings, 57 of 1123 plans have it (master theses and year-long practicum courses such as PRA1-401, IDR507, HI-501).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: .anon_uia() strips the title stamp only in the single-semester form '\((Høst|Vår|Haust)\s+\d{4}\)'. The range form falls through to .anon_generic(), whose season+year regex removes 'Haust 2024' and 'Vår 2025' one at a time. The emptied-bracket cleanup '[ \t]+\([ \t]*\)' does not match because the en dash is still inside.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_uia(), extend the title pattern to an optional range: str_remove_all("\\((?:Høst|Vår|Haust)\\s+\\d{4}(?:\\s*[–-]\\s*(?:Høst|Vår|Haust)\\s+\\d{4})?\\)"). As a general safety net, also let the emptied-bracket cleanup in .anon_generic() accept a lone dash: "[ \\t]+\\([ \\t]*[–-]?[ \\t]*\\)". Add a test case '(Haust 2024–Vår 2025)' to test-anonymize.R.

findings.evidence: Undervisningssemester: [−Haust−] og Vår Undervisningsspråk: Norsk. Varigheit: 1
findings.description: The teaching-semester value 'Haust og Vår' / 'Høst og Vår' is only half removed: the first season word goes, the second stays, so the plan reads 'Undervisningssemester:\n og Vår'. That is a half-removed phrase, and it now wrongly suggests the course is taught only in spring. The anonymizer otherwise drops bare teaching-semester words on purpose (all other UiA plans have an empty 'Undervisningssemester:'), so the remaining 'Vår' is also inconsistent with that rule. 20 of 1123 UiA plans are affected (6 'Haust og Vår', 14 'Høst og Vår').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In .anon_generic(), the season-in-semester-context rule '(?<=(?:semester|undervisning|...)[:\s]{0,3})(høst|vår|haust|...)' is anchored by a lookbehind on the label. It matches only the first season word after 'Undervisningssemester:'. The word after 'og' is not next to a semester keyword.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_generic(), let the lookbehind rule consume a coordinated second season: '(?i)(?<=(?:semester|undervisning|oppstart|startsemester|eksamen)[:\s]{0,3})(?:høst|vår|haust|autumn|spring|sommer|summer)(?:[ \t]*(?:og|and|/|,)[ \t]*(?:høst|vår|haust|autumn|spring|sommer|summer))*'. Or, in .anon_uia(), blank the whole value line after 'Undervisningssemester:'. Add a test 'Undervisningssemester:\nHaust og Vår' -> 'Undervisningssemester:'.
